solutions.title: Search from each cell
solutions.strategy: For every cell, run a DFS downhill to see whether both border sets can be reached.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell can explore much of the grid.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A visited set is needed per search.

solutions.title: Reverse border DFS
solutions.strategy: Start from each ocean border and move uphill; cells reached by both traversals are answers.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each ocean traversal visits each cell at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Two reachability matrices and traversal stack are stored.
